governing_line: The body after death is not logistics; it is custody, relationship, authority, paperwork, culture, labor, and continuing bond.

clusters.name: Custody chain, release, holding, authorization, and paperwork
clusters.danger: turning jurisdictional/provider processes into universal instructions

clusters.name: Funeral arrangement, price, embalming, preparation, and viewing agency
clusters.danger: money pressure, body-condition voyeurism, and false requirement language

clusters.name: Cremation, ashes, burial, cemetery time, green burial, and newer disposition methods
clusters.danger: availability, legality, cost, and environmental claims are unstable and local

clusters.name: Autopsy, postmortem examination, body donation, organ/eye/tissue donation, and body gifts
clusters.danger: consent, official authority, donor eligibility, family history, and body access cannot be generalized

clusters.name: Transport, repatriation, personal effects, disinterment, and boundary firebreak
clusters.danger: legal advice, family conflict adjudication, and false finality

publication_posture: all body-disposition records blocked pending funeral/regulatory, legal/jurisdictional, ethics, privacy, cultural/tradition, official-trace where applicable, donation/autopsy where applicable, and publication-language review
